mapper.sql: SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT '' AS ROWFLAG, ROWNUM AS RNUM, COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_RECORDS, DATA.* FROM (
mapper.select: SELECT A.COMPANY_CODE, A.DIVISION_CODE, A.REGIST_RCEPT_NO, A.SUBMIT_NO, A.RECV_DOC_TYPE, CASE WHEN A.RECV_DOC_TYPE = '9' THEN '원본' WHEN A.RECV_DOC_TYPE = '1' THEN '취하' WHEN A.RECV_DOC_TYPE = '35' THEN '재전송(정정)' END AS RECV_DOC_TYPE_NAME, A.CHIT_FRMTRM_DATE, A.FROM_COMPANY_NAME, A.FROM_ECTMRK, A.TOT_TAX, A.HS_CODE, A.ISSUE_TYPE, CASE WHEN A.ISSUE_TYPE = '02' THEN '기납증' WHEN A.ISSUE_TYPE = '04' THEN '분증' END ISSUE_TYPE_NAME, A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW, A.ACCMLT_ORDER_QY, A.BASS_UNIT FROM AN_CTRM_CMMN A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.REGIST_RCEPT_NO = #{REGIST_RCEPT_NO} AND A.SUBMIT_NO = #{SUBMIT_NO} AND A.ISSUE_TYPE = #{ISSUE_TYPE}

select.if: SELECT A.SEQ ,A.IMPDEC_NO ,A.LNE_NO ,A.POUCH_NO ,A.RAWMTRL_CODE AS ITEM_CODE ,A.ITEM_NM ,A.USGQTY AS QTY ,A.BASS_UNIT ,A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,A.CSTMS ,A.BASIS_DOC_NO FROM AN_CTRM_THING_RAWMTRL A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.REGIST_RCEPT_NO = #{REGIST_RCEPT_NO} AND A.SUBMIT_NO = #{SUBMIT_NO}

SELECT A.SEQ ,NULL AS IMPDEC_NO ,NULL AS LNE_NO ,NULL AS POUCH_NO ,A.ITEM_CODE ,A.ITEM_NM ,A.USGQTY AS QTY ,A.BASS_UNIT ,A.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,A.CSTMS ,A.BASIS_DOC_NO FROM AN_CTRM_TRGET_THNG A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.REGIST_RCEPT_NO = #{REGIST_RCEPT_NO} AND A.SUBMIT_NO = #{SUBMIT_NO}

mapper.select: SELECT B.SUPT_DOC_CODE ,B.COMPANY_CODE ,B.DIVISION_CODE ,B.SUPT_DOC_ITEM_SEQ ,B.ITEM_CODE ,B.ITEM_NM ,B.QY ,B.UNIT_PRICE ,B.BASS_UNIT ,B.AMOUNT ,B.HS_CODE10 ,B.USE_YN ,TO_CHAR(B.CREATE_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD') AS CREATE_DATE ,B.CREATE_BY ,TO_CHAR(B.UPDATE_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD') AS UPDATE_DATE ,B.UPDATE_BY FROM SUPT_DOC_HDR A INNER JOIN SUPT_DOC_ITEM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.SUPT_DOC_CODE = B.SUPT_DOC_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{P_DIVISION_CODE} AND A.SUPT_DOC_NO = #{P_SUPT_DOC_NO} AND A.SUPT_DOC_CODE = #{P_SUPT_DOC_CODE}
